answer: The dawn explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the voyage binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 9 separate vaults needs a separate funded ridge account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 453 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
